{
  "$comment": [
    "Built-in Z.ai model catalog — the zero-config provider every tagent ships with.",
    "",
    "This file is the default list. Users can override or extend it WITHOUT touching",
    "the binary: create ~/.tagent/zai-models.json (global) or <workspace>/.tagent/",
    "zai-models.json (per project) with the same shape — entries with the same id",
    "replace the built-ins, new ids are appended. Set \"replace\": true at the top",
    "level to use ONLY the models in your file.",
    "",
    "Fields: id (sent to the API), label (shown in pickers), vision (accepts image",
    "input — enables screenshot verification in test mode), description (short note)."
  ],
  "models": [
    {
      "id": "glm-4.7",
      "label": "GLM-4.7 (default)",
      "vision": true,
      "contextWindow": 131072,
      "description": "flagship — best overall quality"
    },
    {
      "id": "glm-4.6",
      "label": "GLM-4.6",
      "vision": true,
      "contextWindow": 131072,
      "description": "previous flagship — solid all-rounder"
    },
    {
      "id": "glm-4.5v",
      "label": "GLM-4.5V",
      "vision": true,
      "contextWindow": 131072,
      "description": "vision-optimized — strongest at image understanding"
    },
    {
      "id": "glm-4.5-air",
      "label": "GLM-4.5 Air",
      "vision": false,
      "contextWindow": 131072,
      "description": "lightweight — fastest + cheapest"
    }
  ]
}
